chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥassin ibn Aḥmad, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥubāb, from Yūnus, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Fāṭimah عليها السلام used to come to the graves of the martyrs every Saturday morning. She would come to the grave of Ḥamzah, ask mercy for him, and seek forgiveness for him.

key_terms.تَتَرَحَّمُ: she asks Allah to bestow mercy
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Did Fāṭimah عليها السلام visit the graves of the martyrs and pray for Ḥamzah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Fāṭimah عليها السلام regularly visited the graves of the martyrs, especially the grave of Ḥamzah. It highlights remembrance of the righteous dead and the practice of praying for them through mercy and seeking forgiveness.
